bullets.text: Q1 CR 92.7 with written premium +8.2%; Commercial Lines achieved an 83.2 CR; special lines loss costs were low; corporate target remains CR at or below 96 while growing as fast as possible.

Agency auto remains our greatest concern and growth opportunity, with a tested product design scheduled to roll out to 16 further states; Direct auto achieved low double-digit sales growth with increasing prospects and conversion.

Written premium grew 8.2% in Q1; Commercial Lines grew 15%, becoming a big contributor to overall results; Direct auto achieved low double-digit sales growth, with prospects and conversion both increasing.

Outlook for future rate need is modest; local weather-impact analyses separate observed from expected influences to resist reacting to false positives; state rate-need models now incorporate gas price variables.

Fully taxable equivalent total return was 1.1% (-30 bps YOY); short fixed-income duration maintained; $400M debt issued in January; capital prepared for closed ARX transaction, with Property reporting planned.

Delivered a significant phase of the unified quoting experience platform across laptops, desktops, phones, and tablets; large Snapshot user samples enhance measuring gas price effects on miles driven and frequency changes.

Personal auto experienced higher winter loss costs before a more favorable March; special lines operated at predictably low loss costs; Snapshot's large sample enhances measuring gas price effects on driving and frequency.

Commercial Lines generated positive build in PIF; auto retention tracked mid-2014 rate actions, with recent actions and modest future rate need supporting a more positive customer retention outlook going forward.

Direct marketing yield was very strong, easily supporting incremental Q1 spend; management will push marketing to higher spend levels provided incremental cost per sale matches yield and pricing models.

Focused on Destination Strategy execution, Agency auto improvements, and confirmed retention trends; ARX control position will introduce Property segment reporting; CFO Brian Domeck retires after eight years.
